features.name: Dexterous Feet
features.description: As a bonus action, you can use your feet to manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, or pick up or set down a Tiny object.

features.name: Vanara Dodge
features.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Bite
features.description: You can use your bite to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.
